description:
DOCS-004: Build documentation explains generated `Makefile.inc` and generator integration only briefly and contains spelling errors in names developers will copy (`Makefie.inc`, `usuall`). It also does not explain that `Makefile.drv` invokes `$(BUILD_BIN)/indigo_generator`, so a developer must build the generator before relying on automatic `.driver` regeneration. Clarify prerequisites and correct the names.

Imported from .factory/findings/archive/FND-000004.json (category: quality, blocking: no).
